implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit transport, dynamic pre-SOF table ownership, first-SOS DQT release, actual-only coefficient planes, exact current post-SOF Huffman payloads and validated-EOI final-ready compaction

cases.mechanismPressure: session starts with only the fixed 414-byte transport; before SOF2 this source owns exactly two 64-byte DQT slots, while the 2432-byte future pre-frame authority remains admission-only
large coefficient/control phases remain unchanged while pre-SOF retained table payload stays at two present DQT slots rather than the maximum four-DQT/eight-DHT authority
pre-SOF exact ownership composes with later restart-heavy suspension without changing rollback, transport, RGB or final-ready compaction semantics

requiredInvariants: All v10 transport, source-authority, DQT latch, actual coefficient geometry, dynamic post-SOF Huffman, preview backing, restart and EOI compaction invariants remain unchanged.

PreFrameTableState no longer allocates one fixed arena. A DQT selector allocates one 64-byte payload only on first definition; a pre-SOF DHT selector allocates one fixed 272-byte capacity only on first definition so later redefinition can overwrite in place without replacement coexistence.
Selector identity is represented by optional slot ownership in the store and is not duplicated in codec-owned semantic byte charge, matching the post-SOF Huffman ownership model.

The maximum pre-frame authority is exactly 2432 bytes: four 64-byte DQT slots plus eight 272-byte DHT slot capacities. initialRetainedByteCharge is therefore 414+2432=2846 bytes and remains the constructor admission floor for arbitrary valid pre-SOF table definitions.
Actual initial retained state is exactly the 414-byte TransportBuffer. No table payload exists before a DQT/DHT definition is accepted.

All three retained sources define only DQT0 and DQT1 before SOF2 and no pre-SOF DHT, so maximumObservedPreFrameTableBytes is exactly 128 bytes. At SOF2 the dynamic pre-frame ownership is copied into frame quantization/Huffman authority and then released.
Final-ready retainedPreFrameTableBytes is exactly zero, while the historical pre-frame high-water remains observable after SOF/EOI compaction.

The maximum SOF transition/operation model still uses the full pre-frame authority rather than the 128-byte corpus high-water. Dynamic current retained state must not narrow future-table admission or the frame-transition coexistence bound.

Removing legacy pre-frame Huffman symbol-count/presence arrays lowers the maximum pre-frame authority by 28 bytes relative to v10. The retained sources' operation peaks remain unchanged because later render/entropy phases dominate.
Final-ready retained values remain v10 RGB-only values: tiny 897 bytes, noise576 995328 bytes, restart64 12288 bytes. Their operation peaks remain 8095, 2010910 and 30494 bytes respectively.

This profile does not qualify malloc headers, allocator size classes, Swift object/pointer fields, physical RSS, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes or perceptual reconstruction quality.
